positive.broker: GNOME Secret Service, private D-Bus and tmpfs login collection

timing: Monotonic time from invoking the native credential write to verifying the REST recipient accepted the selected identity and returned text; AG-UI and MCP HTTP calls followed. No explicit service reload or restart.

environment.keyringStorage: tmpfs login collection, separate D-Bus session

reproduction: Extract /usr/local/bin/openai-proxy unchanged from the candidate image, verify its SHA-256, and place it alongside broker.py and the verified Linux arm64 OpenCode executable as opencode.
Build the helper image from fixtures/keyring/Dockerfile.

Launch the helper image with --rm --network none --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --user 65534:65534 --tmpfs /w:uid=65534,gid=65534,mode=0700. Mount the fixture directory read-only at /opt/fixture. Set HOME=/w and XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/w/runtime.
mkdir -m 700 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" && dbus-run-session -- sh -c 'printf fixture-pass | gnome-keyring-daemon --unlock --components=secrets >/dev/null && exec python3 -B /opt/fixture/broker.py'
limitation: The Linux Secret Service is the broker covered by this subcase. macOS Keychain was not accessed. Signed-out GET /v1/models returned HTTP 500 on this candidate; the contract checks denial and zero stale inventory.
